Subject: Draft AWS product description & compliance footnote

Hi team —

Thanks again for the fast turnaround on the listing draft. Attached is our working product page copy (aws_listing_draft_v2.docx) plus a short SOC2 excerpt that the customer asked to reference. A few asks from Acme before we upload to the public catalog: 

- Can you confirm the compliance footnote wording about telemetry and data retention? They want a sentence that is short and non-technical but accurate for customers in regulated industries.
- The hero one-liner is currently ~18 words — can we tighten to 12–14 words?
- Any legal flags on the phrase "persistent storage of user prompts" — Acme's legal prefers "retained for service improvement" wording if accurate.

We'd like to get this finalized and scheduled for AWS review by Friday. Any quick edits you can share inline are appreciated.

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft AWS product description & compliance footnote

Hi Jared —

Thanks — good draft. Quick notes inline and a couple of proposed rewrites below. I updated the attached draft (see aws_listing_draft_v2.docx) with tracked changes:

1) Hero one-liner (suggested shorter option):
   "High-throughput LLM inference with predictable latency and lower TCO."
   (13 words) — keeps the performance + cost hook.

2) Compliance footnote — goal: plain language, accurate, and not overly specific about internal telemetry. My recommended wording for the footnote: 
   "We collect minimal service telemetry (latency, errors) to operate and improve the service. Customer data is processed only to provide the service and is not used for product training without explicit agreement."

   Notes: this avoids the term "persistent storage of user prompts" and instead says "processed" and references training only by agreement. If Acme wants a stronger data residency callout we can add a second sentence that references regional hosting.

3) Legal flag: Kimberly, can you confirm the legal acceptability of the second sentence above (training by agreement)? If not, propose alternate language.

4) Callout placement: I recommend the compliance sentence be a small footnote under the pricing bullet list rather than in the hero panel — keeps hero focused and reduces legal risk for claims.

I'm happy to hop on a 15-min call today if you want to walk through the changes.

[Attachment: aws_listing_draft_v2.docx (updated, 36KB)]

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Partner Manager — Marketplace
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft AWS product description & compliance footnote

LGTM overall. Small legal tweak below (inline):

- Replace "Customer data is processed only to provide the service" with "Customer data is processed only to provide and improve the service, in accordance with contract terms."

That clarifies improvement is permitted when covered by contract and keeps it operational. Also prefer "retain" over "store" when describing short-term logs: "we retain operational logs for up to 30 days" if Acme wants timeframe stated.

No other flags from my side — Hannah feel free to finalize and I'll sign off before upload.

—Kimberly
General Counsel (external ops review)
Redwood Inference
